    Profile

    Soren is a mysterious man with no recollection of his past. He is the Speaker of a peculiar village with an incredible talent for Alchemy. A traveller showed Soren that people need to fend for themselves to grow, so he left with the traveller to discover more about his own past.

    Origin: Saga Region
    Gender: Male
    Height: 158cm
    Weight: 42kg
    Birthday: ???
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Small animals
    Hobbies: Discovering his past
    Illust: gumi Asia
    CV: 寺島愛
